description:
The audit's host harness measured the develop pipeline off-device
(17.5/61.8/62.4/107.9 ms at the 1280 tier for neutral / AgX /
+managed-LUT / +temporal-NR on the 4K fixture), but the production
path had no instrument: nothing on the phone could say which pipeline
actually ran, at what tier, in how many milliseconds, for a given
grade. The owner's A/B comparison had host numbers and no device
numbers.

New engine/RenderTrace.kt: ONE logcat line per completed editor render
under the stable tag "ritim-trace" (the ritim-stab-timing precedent),
debug-gated via BuildConfig.DEBUG (the PreviewMetrics precedent —
release never logs):

  seq=12 frame=34 class=settle req=1280 out=1280x720 backend=cpu
  ms=62 grade=tonemap=agx lut=kodak-2383

- line() is pure (the MetricsSummary precedent): every value is
  caller-supplied, so the JVM tests pin the format with no Android
  classes.
- out= logs the
